main_text.p: ענה Respondit, Exaudivit, quasi re vel verbis petenti respondit: Inde latissime sumitur pro Dixit, Locutus, Allocutus, Prolocutus est, Fatus fuit: Testificatus, Attestatus, Contestatus fuit, & sic fere cum Praepositione ב conjungitur: Clamavit, Acclamavit: Cecinit, Cantavit: Item, Afflixit, Humiliavit, Demisit, Deprelsit se, Afflictus ac Deprelsus fuit, Praeterit. ענה Respondit, Jerem.23.35. ענה Testificatus est contra me, Ruth.1.21. ענה Dixit ei, 1.Sam. 9.v.17.&c. Chald.Praet. ענו Respondeᵲunt, Dan.2.7. ענה Respondit illa, Dan.5.10. Partic. praef. ענה Loquens, Respondens, Dan.2. Plural. ענו Respondebant, Dan.3.24. Niph. נענה Respondere, Exorari, Exoratus respondere: Exaudiri, Affligi: Praeterit. נעניתי Respondebo, quasi Exorabilem vel Respondentem exhibebo mihi, Ezech.14.4. Afflictus sum, Psal.119.107. Part. נענה Afflictus est, Jesa.53.7. Item Respondebo, Respondens ero, Sinam me induci ut respondeam, Ezech.14.7. Fœm. נענה Afflicta, Jef.58.10. Inf. לענות Demittere, Abjicere se, Exod.10.3. pro לענות cui simile vide in ראה in Niphal. Fut. ייענה Exaudiar, Job.19.7. Pih. ענה Afflixit, Comprefsit, Subegit, pudicitia sc. violanda causa: Cecinit, Cantavit: Praet. לא ענה Non afflixit, Thren.3.33. עניתה Comprefsifti eam, Deut.21.14. Infin. ענות Cantare, Exod. 32.18. Ps.88.1. Imp. ענו אותם Et comprimite eas, Jud.19. v.24. Pyh.Praet. כי עניתי Quod affligor, Psal.119.71. Part. מענה Afflictus, Jef.53.4. Infinit. את כל־ענותו Omnis affligi ejus, id est, omnium afflictionum ejus, Psalm.132. v.1. Hiph. Partic. מענה בשמחת לבו Respondet, Annuit, Testimonium perhibet laetitia cordis ejus, Eccles.5.19. Futur. יענני Respondere facit me, Job.20.3. & Job.31.35. juxta quosdam: ויענני Et contestabitur stos, Psalm.55.20. Vix plura

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied as printed in the scan. Several Hebrew forms and their vowel points are small and hard to read at this resolution; the letters are the most likely reading, not checked letter by letter. The Chaldaic form "Respondeᵲunt" is uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The Hebrew headword and most forms are not verified. The running head is a Hebrew catchword printed at the top centre. Because the scan is low resolution, the Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are not reliably reproduced.
